title: Umbra SAR GEC (TEST)
description: TEST COLLECTION -- not for production use. Exercises the dps-output-discover Lambda end to end: routing, relocation into ProgramData/, and the veda_discover DAG trigger. Discovers from ProgramData/Umbra/GECTest/, a namespace no other config touches -- nothing else in the repo declares any ProgramData/Umbra prefix, so there is no collision in either direction. The trailing slash keeps a future sibling such as GECTest2/ from being absorbed. Renders greyscale with no rescale, because no Umbra raster has been inspected yet; set rescale from real pixel statistics before treating this as anything but a pipeline test. Safe to delete once the pipeline is verified.
